messages:
Maya L: Heads-up — we've detected webhook delivery failures and partial import errors for tenants onboarded between 02:40-03:05 UTC in ap-south-1. Roughly 12% of webhook callbacks returned 502/504.
Ravi K: Investigating. initial trace shows a spike in queue depth causing timeouts to the webhook-worker. scaling didn't kick fast enough.
Lena H: Ops - can we get a list of impacted accounts + contact emails so CS can start outreach?
ops-bot: Alert ALRT-2026-541: webhook-worker timeouts in ap-south-1. Autoscale triggered but lagged due to image-pull backlog.
Ravi K: posted impacted list to the incident folder: https://redwood.internal/incidents/ALRT-2026-541/impacted.csv (internal). 31 tenants affected; 11 enterprise, 20 self-serve.
Maya L: draft outreach for self-serve (short):
Maya L: "Hi <Name>,
We're reaching out because we observed transient webhook failures and partial onboarding for accounts created between 02:40–03:05 UTC in ap-south-1. Our engineers resolved the issue at 03:12 UTC and requeued failed jobs. If you notice missing data or retry errors, reply and we'll re-run the onboarding or walk you through fixes. We're also offering a one-time service credit for impacted onboarding.
Apologies for the disruption — Maya on behalf of Redwood CS"
Zoe T: Add: "No customer data was exposed." and "If this affects a launch/renewal timeline let us know — we'll prioritize."
Nate B: technical note: root cause = image-pull storms during a deploy combined with underprovisioned init slots for webhook-workers. Patch: reduced init parallelism and improved backoff. Deployed 03:10 UTC.
Lena H: For enterprise tenants, we'll include a personal outreach + bridge offer. I'll coordinate invites.
Maya L: Who will send the self-serve batch? I can send now in waves to avoid rate limits.
Lena H: I'll take the 11 enterprise sends. include the exec note and link to the incident page.
Ravi K: We've labeled affected tenants with tag "onboard-webhook-failed" in the UI. ops will also attach timeline logs.
Maya L: Quick Q — do we proactively apply credits or wait for requests?
Lena H: Proactive for enterprise only. Self-serve: credit on request after we confirm failure.
Zoe T: Received reply from OneKart (enterprise) asking for immediate re-run and an SLA note. Lena — can you handle bridge?
Lena H: Yes, scheduling bridge 04:00-05:00 IST. sending invites now.
Nate B: Metrics: error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.6% within 2 minutes of deploy. We're keeping alert window open for 4 hours.
Maya L: Sending self-serve messages in staggered batches (5/min). will post delivery status.
Ravi K: I'll compile RCA draft in 48hrs and include mitigation steps for deploy image-pull storms.
Maya L: Sent initial messages to 20 self-serve tenants; 4 replies (3 re-run requests, 1 confirmation ok).
Lena H: Enterprise sends done, scheduled 3 bridges for tomorrow too per customer ask. also flagged renewal risk on Salesforce records for the 11 accounts.
Maya L: Thanks team — reconvene in 90 minutes to triage any escalations. :handshake:
